description: Exercise the real x402 payment-flow loop at a nominal $0.01 — the cheapest metered call on this server, priced just above $0 so the probe can't be run up for free without limit. Call it once with no payment credential (no auth required) to receive a 402-style payment_required challenge (the exact same shape every real paid tool returns, and requesting it is itself free); retry the same tools/call carrying a payment credential in Authorization (with your API key moved to X-Axis-Key) to settle at $0.01 and get a success envelope. Learn the vocabulary here before paying real money for prepare_agentic_purchasing or analyze_repo. No side effects on any other tool, no real payment rail is ever touched.

examples.name: First call, no payment credential — receives the challenge
examples.output: {"error":"Payment Required","message":"This is a free payment-flow probe. Fulfil the x402 challenge and retry the same tools/call with the payment credential.","price":"0.00","currency":"USD","_payment_required":true,"tool":"ping_payment","amount_cents":0,"retry":{"method":"tools/call","name":"ping_payment","headers_hint":["Authorization: <payment credential> — replaces the Bearer API key for this one retry","X-Axis-Key: <api_key> — your normal API key moves here on the retry"]}}

examples.name: Retry with a payment credential in Authorization — succeeds at $0.01
examples.output: {"ok":true,"tool":"ping_payment","settled_cents":1,"price_usd":"0.01","message":"Payment flow exercised successfully. You now know how to pay for any metered AXIS tool.","next":"Call prepare_agentic_purchasing or analyze_repo — same 402 vocabulary applies at real prices."}

name: ping_payment

price_usd.description: settled_cents formatted as a dollar string — success responses only.

settled_cents.description: Amount actually settled on a successful retry, in cents (1 = $0.01). Always 0 on the initial challenge (amount_cents), which is a separate field.
